summary: All four plan phases executed and committed. Phase 1: made instDecidableLJDerivable and instDecidableDerivableInIPL computable in Cslib/Logics/Propositional/SequentCalculus/LJ/Decidability.lean via a new ljListDerivableDecidable helper eliminated through Quotient.recOnSubsingleton, preserving the ivalid_universe_invariant bridge verbatim; corrected five docstring sites to state ctxToImp's noncomputability is inherent. Phase 2: the same shape in LK/Decidability.lean (lkListDerivableDecidable, instDecidableLKDerivable, instDecidableDerivableInCPL), no universe bridge needed. Phase 3: added CslibTests/ContextDecidability.lean with #guard_msgs-protected #eval assertions on non-empty contexts for LJ/LK (positive/negative), the excluded-middle intuitionistic/classical contrast, and the DerivableIn forms; registered in the CslibTests.lean barrel. Phase 4: full seven-step CSLib CI order passes (build, checkInitImports, lint, lint-style, test, mk_all --module, plus cache get). The axiom-census outcome diverged from the plan's prediction -- instead of one new tainted line, the live tainted set dropped by 17 names (pure improvement, 0 regressions) because prior already-committed sorry-repair work in the tableau completeness files had never re-baselined the ratchet; investigated via git log/git status, confirmed unrelated to this task's own edits, and re-tightened. Also fixed one line of pre-existing unrelated Cslib.lean barrel drift (Cslib.Foundations.Logic.Operators, from task 619) surfaced by mk_all. Zero of the four target instances carries noncomputable; zero new sorry/axioms/vacuous defs in any touched file.
